title: Tight Information Complexity of the Coin Problem in the Broadcast Model
summary: We study distributed testing of $\mathrm{Ber}(α)$ versus $\mathrm{Ber}(β)$ in the broadcast, or shared-blackboard, model. For protocols with constant advantage, we characterise up to universal constant factors the information complexity under either hypothesis for every pair $β<α$. The characterisation shows that the two information costs can be quite different and identifies three parameter regimes, with optimal protocols based respectively on clean samples, a noisy binary symmetric channel, and an asymmetric $Z$-channel.
